about_blocks.text: Heritage Treatment Foundation: A Non-12-Step Approach to Addiction Treatment
about_blocks.html: Heritage Treatment Foundation: A Non-12-Step Approach to Addiction Treatment

about_blocks.text: Heritage Treatment Foundation is a residential treatment center located just an hour away from Montreal that specializes in a non-12-Step approach to addiction treatment. They provide evidence-based treatments that focus on psychotherapy, pharmacotherapy, and alternative therapies to address both addiction and underlying mental health issues. All treatments are personalized to the client’s specific needs.
about_blocks.html: Heritage Treatment Foundation is a residential treatment center located just an hour away from Montreal that specializes in a non-12-Step approach to addiction treatment. They provide evidence-based treatments that focus on psychotherapy, pharmacotherapy, and alternative therapies to address both addiction and underlying mental health issues. All treatments are personalized to the client’s specific needs.

about_blocks.text: Heritage Treatment Foundation’s emphasis on positive psychology is vital to their clients’ recovery. They believe that the process of addiction treatment is about reinventing oneself as a happier, sober, stronger person. They work toward this goal by offering a variety of evidence-based therapies like cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT), rational emotive behavioural therapy (REBT), psychodynamic therapy, and cognitive bias modification therapy, both in individual and group psychotherapy sessions. Clients with certain conditions may receive medication-assisted treatment.

about_blocks.text: The Heritage Treatment Foundation’s intimate size allows them to provide more attention to each client. They accept only 12 clients at a time. Their on-site detox, aftercare program, and strong alumni support through weekly meetings ensure that clients are supported throughout their recovery journey.

about_blocks.html: Comfortable Cottage Home: A Relaxing Place for Healing with Alternative Therapies

about_blocks.text: Heritage Treatment Foundation’s residential facility offers a comfortable cottage home where clients can relax and heal. The bedrooms are air-conditioned and equipped with high speed internet and a television. Clients are encouraged to participate in various alternative therapies that promote relaxation, wellness, and healing.

about_blocks.text: Heritage Home Treatment Foundation is a leading residential rehab center situated just a short drive away from Montreal, Quebec, Canada. As a non-profit, non-12-step facility, the center has been offering professional support and care to individuals struggling with addiction issues for several years. The facility accommodates up to 12 residents at any given time, who are embraced in a supportive, private, and serene environment that helps them overcome addiction.

about_blocks.text: Apart from treating addiction, Heritage Home Treatment Foundation addresses the underlying causes that often fuel addictive behavior by using evidence-based treatments. From psychotherapy and pharmacotherapy to holistic healing techniques that may involve yoga and meditation, every treatment program is individualized to meet the specific needs of each resident. With a focus on lifelong recovery, graduates of the program can look forward to a future full of sobriety, balanced emotional, and mental wellness, and a supportive community network that can help them cope with everyday life.
